title: Dumas Bay Centre

services.name: Rental Spaces
services.desc: From group retreats to training sessions and board meetings, Dumas Bay Centre will welcome your group with attentive and hospitable service, flexible meeting spaces and a picturesque location. We offer multi-purpose meeting rooms to accommodate all of your personal and work events, group gatherings, and special occasions. We’re located in a beautiful and lush area between Seattle and Tacoma, with easy access to major highways and Sea-Tac International Airport. Enjoy gorgeous views of Puget Sound and the Olympic Mountains through our large bay windows or take a stroll through our Sound-facing garden area.
